name: Heard vs Mentaya
title: Heard vs Mentaya: Bookkeeping vs Free OON Claims for Therapists
description: Compare Heard (bookkeeping and taxes, $129/mo) vs Mentaya (free OON claims submission with 5% client fee). Different financial services for therapy practices.

summary.bottom_line: Heard and Mentaya solve completely different problems. Heard provides done-for-you bookkeeping and tax services ($129/mo) for managing practice finances. Mentaya is a free OON claims submission platform (clients pay 5%) that eliminates superbills with a 100% refund guarantee. They're complementary - most OON therapists could use both.

key_differences.service_type: Heard: Bookkeeping + taxes | Mentaya: OON claims billing
key_differences.unique_feature: Heard: Quarterly tax estimates | Mentaya: 100% refund guarantee

rows.entity_b: Yes - offer free claims as a benefit

sections.heading: Different Financial Needs
sections.content: Heard and Mentaya address completely different aspects of running a therapy practice. Heard manages your business finances: monthly bookkeeping, expense categorization, quarterly tax estimates, and annual filing. Mentaya handles client insurance: automatically submitting OON claims, handling denials and appeals, and guaranteeing refunds if claims fail. An OON therapist likely needs both.

sections.heading: Cost Structures
sections.content: Heard charges therapists $129/mo (Lite), ~$199/mo (Essential), or higher for S-Corps, plus $750 for annual tax filing. Mentaya is completely free for therapists - clients pay 5% per claim (about $7.50-10 on a $150-200 session). Therapists can optionally absorb Mentaya's client fee to offer claims submission as a complimentary service.

sections.heading: Mentaya's Guarantee
sections.content: Mentaya's 100% refund guarantee is unique: if they can't successfully submit a claim, they refund all fees. They handle denial appeals and resubmissions at no extra cost. This removes risk from OON billing. Heard's value is in avoiding tax mistakes - quarterly estimates help prevent surprise tax bills.

recommendations.when: You need help managing practice finances, hate bookkeeping, or want accurate tax estimates.
You're out-of-network and want to help clients use their benefits without superbills.
You're an OON solo practitioner wanting comprehensive financial and billing support.
You're in-network - Mentaya is only for out-of-network claims.

faqs.q: Can I use Heard and Mentaya together?
faqs.a: Yes. Heard handles bookkeeping/taxes while Mentaya handles OON claims. They're completely complementary services for different aspects of practice management.
Mentaya charges clients 5% of each claim upon receiving reimbursement. For a $200 session, that's about $10. Therapists can optionally absorb this fee to offer free claims submission.

faqs.q: Does Heard help with insurance billing?
faqs.a: No. Heard is strictly for bookkeeping and taxes - it doesn't handle insurance claims or billing. You'd need Mentaya, Thrizer, or another platform for that.
If Mentaya can't successfully submit a claim, they refund 100% of fees. They also handle denials and resubmissions at no additional cost.
